conservative.requirements: Tools at hand, engaged with target. You must perform the prepare manoeuvre before performing this action.

success.description: You improvise a repair on a damaged device, building feature, or other item. It’s not proper, but desperate times...

sigmarsComet.description: A single numerical trait of the item is improved by 1 while this card is recharging. 4 Rush a miracle worker and you get a rotten miracle. Remove 1 recharge token from this card.

reckless.requirements: must p\:rform the prepare manoeuvre before performing this action. Special: The GM may modify the difficulty of this action based on the complexity of the item being repaired. Effect: Your repairs are adequate, but they won't hold forever. While this card is recharging, the affected item is repaired its damaged condition, if any, is and its Unreliable rating, if any, is improved (increased) by 1.
